body.html: Boonrapee Residence Hotel Yala is a 60-room residence-style stay on Siroros Road in Sateng, Yala city, near Yala Hospital. It is positioned as an affordable property that leans on clean, simple rooms and a central location rather than luxury. With its setting near the hospital and in town, it suits business travellers, people visiting patients, visitors exploring Yala city, and anyone wanting clean rooms at a light price.

The thing reviews mention first is the clean, modern-looking rooms. Voices from real guest reviews describe roomy-enough rooms with simple, contemporary decor that look newer than the price suggests, and a frequent compliment is the soft, comfortable beds. Another point raised is friendly, helpful staff, plus on-site parking and security, which is reassuring if you drive yourself. The overall feel is a small residence that is quieter than a high-rise city hotel.
"Clean room, modern and looking new, with a really soft, comfy bed. Lovely helpful staff, in town near the hospital and a convenience store. Great value for an overnight stay."

On the rooms, there are several types: Superior with twin or large beds, Grand Deluxe, larger Executive and Junior Suite rooms, plus Family rooms and a President Suite. Rooms have air-conditioning, a refrigerator, a flat-screen TV, hot water and drinking water. Most reviews say the rooms are clean, the beds are comfortable and the in-room basics are complete for the price. The thing to understand is that this is an affordable residence without resort-style facilities, and room sizes vary by type, so look at photos and pick the room type that fits your group when booking.

On amenities, there is free parking, free Wi-Fi throughout, a garden and a 24-hour front desk with security. There is an on-site restaurant, but it does not always operate, so check first, or order delivery and eat out nearby. To be clear-eyed, there is no swimming pool, and breakfast depends on the rate you book. The location near Yala Hospital, convenience stores and restaurants makes finding food easy.

Worth knowing before you book: this is a small property in town, and parking is limited, so it can fill up when busy — arrive earlier in the day or ask about parking ahead. Being near Yala Hospital is very handy if you are visiting a patient or seeing a doctor, but it also means the area has its busy, traffic-heavy moments. For exploring the city or driving on to Betong, it is a clean, wallet-friendly stop at a standard that is hard to find at this price.

In short, Boonrapee Residence Hotel Yala suits travellers who value clean rooms, a central location and a low price over luxury or full resort-style facilities. Its strengths are clear: clean, modern rooms, soft beds, free parking, free Wi-Fi and a location near Yala Hospital and the town centre. But if you want a pool, a full breakfast spread or a big-hotel feel, compare it against other hotels in town. For a Yala trip built around business, visiting a patient, exploring the city, or an overnight before Betong, this is a tidy, wallet-friendly base.

A tip from reading the reviews: pick the room type that fits your group and ask for a larger one, since sizes vary. If you drive, ask about parking ahead because it is limited. If you want to eat in-house, check when the restaurant is open or plan to order delivery. Yala and Betong fill up on Thai long weekends and festivals, so rooms go fast; reserve ahead and pick a free-cancellation rate if your plans are not yet firm.

faq.q: Where is Boonrapee Residence Hotel Yala, and what is nearby?
faq.a: It sits at 195/9 Siroros Road, Sateng, Mueang Yala, in the city. It is within walking distance of Yala Hospital and about 2.3 km from Yala train station. Convenience stores, restaurants and the mall and market in town are easy to reach, handy for business, hospital visits and sightseeing.

faq.q: What is the starting price, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start around THB 600/night for a Superior room. There are larger Grand Deluxe rooms, Junior Suite / Executive rooms and Family or President Suite rooms for families and groups. Rates vary by season and holidays, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does it have a swimming pool and parking?
faq.a: There is no swimming pool, but there is free parking, which is limited and can fill up when busy, so arrive earlier or ask ahead. There is free Wi-Fi throughout, a garden and a 24-hour front desk with security. Breakfast depends on the rate you book, so check at booking.

If you want a pool, a full breakfast or a big-hotel feel, compare it with other options in town.
